hero.eyebrow: Agentic quantum brain · Made in Argentina
hero.title: AI agents that think, coordinate and act for your business.
hero.lead: AgentiCuántico is an agentic artificial intelligence platform: autonomous agents that understand your operation, split the work among themselves and respond with voice, judgment and privacy by design.
agent.title: Meet the Agent
agent.lead: Ask anything about AgentiCuántico. It answers with public information, speaks your language and gestures while it explains.
agent.note: Local demo: answers come from a public knowledge base included in this page. Your questions are not sent to our servers.
what.title: A team of agents that works as one mind
what.lead: AgentiCuántico combines specialized agents that perceive, plan and execute, coordinated by a central brain that lives apart from the public website.
what.c1p: They receive a goal, break it into steps and carry it out with authorized tools, asking for confirmation when needed.
what.c2p: An orchestrator distributes tasks among specialists (sales, support, analysis) that work in parallel and merge results.
what.c3p: The private brain is separated from the public website: internal logic, data and keys never travel to the browser.
what.c4p: Text, voice and a 3D avatar with expressive lips and hands for more human conversations in Spanish, English and Portuguese.
cases.title: Where it adds value from day one
cases.lead: Built for SMBs and companies that want to automate with AI in their own language, without losing control.
cases.c1p: Consistent answers over web and messaging, with hand-off to a person when the case requires it.
cases.c2p: Agents that understand the inquiry, qualify the opportunity and prepare the proposal for your sales team.
cases.c3p: Data entry, order tracking, reconciliations and repetitive tasks handled with traceability.
cases.c4p: An assistant that answers about your organization's processes, manuals and regulations, with clear sources.
cases.c5p: Executive summaries, alerts and dashboards narrated in natural language from your data.
cases.c6p: Assistants for safety, maintenance and operations at ports, plants and oil fields.
how.title: From request to action, in an agentic pipeline
how.lead: Inspired by quantum superposition, the brain explores several hypotheses in parallel and converges on the best answer before acting.
how.label: Pipeline stages
how.s1p: Input via text, voice or integrations.
how.s3p: Breaks down the goal and evaluates alternatives in parallel.
how.s4p: Assigns each part to the right specialist agent.
how.s6p: Checks the result and answers with voice and avatar.
how.note: The private brain coordinates every stage; the public website only shows the interface.
tech.title: Neural processing with an interface that feels human
tech.lead: State-of-the-art language models, coordinated by our own agentic layer and presented with voice, lips and hands.
tech.t1p: Language understanding, step-by-step reasoning and context memory for coherent conversations.
tech.t2p: Explores multiple paths at once and picks the strongest one. It is a design metaphor: no quantum hardware required.
tech.t3p: Natural speech synthesis, viseme-based lip sync and hand gestures while the Agent speaks.
tech.t4p: Runs in your phone's browser, installs as an app (PWA) and loads 3D only when needed.
privacy.title: Your information, under your control
privacy.lead: We designed AgentiCuántico so that privacy depends on architecture, not on goodwill.
privacy.p1p: Agent logic and each customer's data live on private infrastructure, never on the public site.
privacy.p2t: Keys stay out of the browser
privacy.p2p: AI and payment provider credentials are stored as server secrets, never in public code.
privacy.p3p: We only ask for what is needed to provide the service, and you can request access, correction or deletion.
privacy.p4p: All traffic travels over HTTPS with strict content security policies.
privacy.p5p: Sensitive actions require a person's confirmation and are logged.
privacy.p6p: Data processing aligned with Argentina's Personal Data Protection Law 25,326.

inv.title: We are building the agentic layer for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking businesses
inv.lead: We are looking for partners who share the vision of AI that is useful, private and close to every business.
inv.visionP: Any organization should be able to add trustworthy AI agents to its team, speaking its language and respecting its data.
inv.marketP: Enterprise adoption of generative AI is growing worldwide, and Latin America still lacks agentic solutions designed for local language, culture and regulations.
inv.diffP: Private-brain architecture, a multimodal avatar experience and a regional focus on Rioplatense Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
inv.r1p: Public website, demo Agent with voice and 3D avatar, private-brain architecture and installable web app.
inv.r2p: First deployments with companies to validate use cases and measure impact.
inv.r3p: Configurable multi-agent orchestration, integrations and a partner API.
inv.r4p: Growth across Latin America with premium voices and industry-specific agents.
inv.disclaimer: The roadmap is indicative and may change. It does not constitute an offer of securities.
inv.ctaP: Interested in investing or partnering? Write to us and we'll share our deck.
faq.title: What people ask us most
faq.a1: An agentic AI platform: autonomous agents that understand requests, plan and execute tasks for businesses, with voice and a 3D avatar.
faq.a2: No. "Quantum" describes an approach inspired by superposition: evaluating several alternatives in parallel before deciding. It runs on conventional cloud infrastructure.
faq.a3: In the private brain, separated from the public website. This site does not store conversations on servers: the demo runs in your browser.
faq.a4: Spanish (with a focus on Rioplatense), English and Brazilian Portuguese, in both text and voice.
faq.q5: How do I pay for a subscription?
faq.a5: In Argentine pesos with Mercado Pago or in US dollars with PayPal, renewed monthly and cancelable anytime.
faq.q6: Can I have agents with my company's knowledge?
faq.a6: Yes, that's the focus of the Empresa (business) plan. Write to us and we'll put together a tailored proposal.
faq.q7: Can I install it on my phone?
faq.a7: Yes. In Chrome on Android, open the menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
final.title: Add AI agents to your team
final.lead: Tell us what you want to automate and we'll reply with a proposal.

priv.title: Privacy policy
priv.intro: This policy explains how AgentiCuántico processes personal data on agenticuantico.dev.ar and its web app, in accordance with Argentina's Personal Data Protection Law 25,326. The Spanish version prevails.
priv.s1: The data controller is AgentiCuántico, a project based in the Argentine Republic. Contact: agenticuantico@gmail.com.
priv.s2l1: Data you send us by email, for example in a business inquiry.
priv.s2l2: If you create an account in the app: your email, your plan and your payment status. Card data is processed by Mercado Pago or PayPal; we never see or store it.
priv.s2l3: Preferences saved in your browser (language, currency and demo conversations) using local storage.
priv.s3: The site demo answers from a public knowledge base included in the page and does not send your questions to our servers. The voice uses your browser's speech synthesizer; some browsers may process the text with their own voice provider.
priv.s4: Answering inquiries, providing the service, managing subscriptions, preventing abuse and complying with legal obligations. We do not sell your data.
priv.s5: We may use cloud infrastructure, AI model and payment providers (Mercado Pago, PayPal) that process data on our behalf with appropriate security measures, which may involve international transfers.
priv.s6: You can request access, rectification, update or deletion of your data by writing to agenticuantico@gmail.com. Access is free of charge at intervals of no less than six months, unless a legitimate interest is shown (art. 14, sec. 3, Law 25,326).
priv.s7: The Agency for Access to Public Information, as the supervisory body of Law 25,326, has the power to handle complaints and claims filed by those whose rights are affected by non-compliance with personal data protection rules.
priv.s8: We may update this policy. The current version will always be published on this page.
terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: By using agenticuantico.dev.ar and the AgentiCuántico app you accept these terms. The Spanish version prevails.
terms.s1: AgentiCuántico provides agentic artificial intelligence tools. The public demo is informational and may contain errors; it does not replace professional advice.
terms.s2: Do not use the service for illegal activities, to infringe third-party rights, to send spam or to attempt unauthorized access to systems.
terms.s3: Paid plans are billed monthly on a recurring basis through Mercado Pago (in pesos) or PayPal (in dollars). You can cancel anytime from your payment method or by writing to us; cancellation prevents future charges. Prices may change with prior notice.
terms.s4: If you subscribed remotely, you can revoke your acceptance within 10 calendar days under Argentina's Consumer Protection Law 24,240 by writing to agenticuantico@gmail.com.
terms.s5: The AgentiCuántico brand, design and software belong to their owners. Content you generate with the service is yours, subject to the licenses of the model providers.
terms.s6: The service is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from the use of AI-generated answers.
terms.s7: These terms are governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic. Contact: agenticuantico@gmail.com.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This site does not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
cookies.s1l1: Local storage (localStorage) to remember your language, chosen currency and, in the app, your demo conversations.
cookies.s1l2: A service worker cache so the site loads fast and works offline.
cookies.s1l3: If you sign in to the app, a strictly necessary, secure, httpOnly session cookie issued by our backend.
cookies.s2: You can delete this data from your browser settings or, in the app, with the "Clear conversations" option.
cookies.s3: If we add analytics in the future, we will announce it on this page and ask for your consent where applicable.
